minutes.headline: Planning Board waived site plan review for a vet clinic and approved the Water District site plan, excluding its sign.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the Water District site plan at 496 Mass Ave after a continued hearing, with the sign left out to return later as an amendment.
The board granted a waiver from site plan review for a veterinary clinic at 324 Electric Avenue, on condition that it conform to other local boards and regulations.
The Water District approval excludes the sign, which must come back as an amendment.
Most of the meeting was a line-by-line review of zoning use-table definitions for recodification, ending with no resolution and several items left for the director to rework.
The board left carryout restaurant off the village district for now, with a special permit suggested elsewhere.

why_it_matters: The use-table review decides which businesses, such as carryout restaurants, are allowed by right or need a special permit in which districts, so it shapes what can open near residents.
The site plan waiver and the sign amendment show which projects get full board review and which get less, which affects what neighbors see and when they can comment.
watch_next: The Water District sign must return to the board as an amendment to the approved site plan.
The director is to bring back research over the summer on pinning lots in the subdivision and ANR process.
